title: Sync trigger clobbers a value written by the new release
description: A compatibility trigger derives a new column while the new release writes that column directly.

requirements.text: email_normalized must hold the newest committed intent: the new release's explicit value, or the lowercased email after an email change.
assumptions: An email change supersedes an earlier explicit normalized value.
A no-op email change (same value as stored) is outside this reference model.
